focus_areas: Link Intersection Integrity: Verify that rings passing through each other do not merge or fuse at the contact points.
Geometric Consistency: Ensure the oval shape of the links remains consistent despite perspective distortion.
Material Realism: Check for natural specular highlights and surface imperfections (scratches/wear) on the metal.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'topology_boundary_auditor' results. In AI-generated chains, the most common failure mode is 'melting' where two links touch. If the topology auditor confirms clean separation at all visible intersections, the structural integrity is high. Also, verify if the depth of field blur looks optical (lens-based) or algorithmic (smearing).
image_description: A close-up, black-and-white macro photograph of a heavy metal chain. The image features a shallow depth of field, with the central links in sharp focus showing metallic texture and wear, while the background links blur into bokeh. The lighting creates high-contrast specular highlights on the curved surfaces of the rings.
